name: @distlab/scenario
description: Scenario validation, deterministic composition, assessment boundaries, and the headless golden harness.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @distlab/contracts --silent && npm run build -w @distlab/kernel --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build -w @distlab/contracts --silent && npm run build -w @distlab/kernel --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/*.test.ts
